# tailscale_tailnets (Data Source)

The tailnets data source describes the tailnets in an organization using the alpha tailnet creation API. Provider OAuth credentials require the tailnets:read scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tailscale_tailnets" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tailnets` (Block List) The list of tailnets in the organization. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--tailnets))

<a id="nestedblock--tailnets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tailnets`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp of the tailnet in RFC3339 format.
- `display_name` (String) The display name for the tailnet.
- `id` (String) The stable, globally unique identifier for the tailnet.
- `org_id` (String) The stable, globally unique identifier for the organization.
